newsitem.title: UK: BSkyB has Q1 subscriber growth of 146,000.
newsitem.headline: BSkyB has Q1 subscriber growth of 146,000.

text.p: British Sky Broadcasting Group Plc said on Friday that it had net subscriber growth of 146,000 in the three months to September 30.
Churn levels, the number of subscription cancellations, were similarly affected in the early part of the year.

But BSkyB, reporting a sharp 31 percent rise in first quarter pretax profits to 66.26 million stg, said subscriber growth had picked up from September, due to the launch of new channels and the continued popularity of the Premier League and for the first time, Nationwide League soccer.
Subscriptions accounted for 86 percent of total revenues, with 73 percent coming from DHT and 13 percent from cable.
